Gibbs.lean: Contains spin/bond/hamiltonian/isingWeight definitions and positivity lemmas

GHSInhomogeneous.lean: Contains relabeling theorems for GHS inequalities
KWGeometricDual.lean: Contains Kramers-Wannier geometric duality definitions and theorems
LebowitzPfisterReplicaOrbitRankFive.lean: Contains replica orbit theorems for rank-5 cases
CheckCenterMarkedPath.lean: Contains #print axioms commands for transitionProduct_cons_snoc and centerMarkedPathSum_eq_sum_sq

DLR.lean: Contains IsDLRState definition for Dobrushin-Lanford-Ruelle states
EvenSubgraphDecomp.lean: Contains Eulerian walk decomposition theorems

summary: All 433 files in this work unit contain formal mathematical content relevant to search. The main files (e.g., Peierls.lean, Gibbs.lean, AizenmanBarsky.lean, GHSInhomogeneous.lean, KWGeometricDual.lean, LebowitzPfisterReplicaOrbitRankFive.lean) contain definitions, theorems, and proofs for Ising model statistical mechanics. The ~100 'Check' files (e.g., CheckCenterMarkedPath.lean, CheckGinibreBoundary.lean) contain executable `#print axioms` commands for axiom dependency verification — these are not pure import aggregators per FILTER-007 since they have executable Lean content. Per FILTER-002 (high evidence bar for hard exclusion), FILTER-004 (content-based boundary), FILTER-021 (no disk optimization at recall expense), and FILTER-025 (default retain), no file meets the criteria for exclusion from the primary index.
